messages:
maya (prod PM): quick sync — we need a final on onboarding acceptance gates + pin TTL for aurora-lite and pegasus-embed. customer 'Atlas' requested a pin exception. proposed checklist below, please react with :thumbsup: / concerns

aj (eng): can you paste the perf numbers we observed? also which hw bucket are we targeting for hosted vs dedicated?

selene (research): ran smokebench on rtx-a6000 and t4-replica. quick summary:
```
aurora-lite (rtx-a6000): p50=48ms, p95=162ms (seq=512), tok/s=2200
pegasus-embed (t4-replica): avg embed time=12ms, mean cosine consistency vs baseline=0.893
```
notes: aurora-lite hits p95 ~162ms so slightly above our 150ms quick target on high seq; quant q4_0 brings p95 -> ~140ms but 0.6% quality delta on summarization microbench.

nora (support): Atlas flagged two asks: 1) pin until they finish offline regression (expected 8 weeks) 2) ability to opt into traffic shadowing on their account. they want SLA on pin behavior (no silent cut).

aj (eng): engineering constraints: 1) we can grant up to 90d soft pin without infra changes. beyond that we need a pinned routing flag + extra capacity commitment. 2) canary tooling supports percent ramp and automated rollback on error-rate or quality-regression hooks.

samir (sde): suggested concrete policy:
- default pin TTL: 90 days (soft pin)
- auto-extension: +30 days if customer opts-in via console and signs a temporary SLA (opt-in checkbox)
- emergency rollback: immediate if runtime error-rate > 0.5% or latency spike p95 > 2x baseline

maya (prod PM): proposed acceptance gates (short checklist) — if we agree i'll publish to the catalog docs and update the pin request form: 
```
onboard acceptance gates v1:
- smokebench perf: hosted p95 <= 150ms OR documented quantization/feature tradeoffs
- correctness: task-specific eval pass rate >= baseline - 2% absolute or explanation & mitigations
- embedding stability (for embed models): mean cosine >= 0.88 vs baseline + schema lock verified
- safety/regression: automated toxicity/regression checks run, delta flagged < 0.5%
- infra: canary plan defined (traffic %, duration) + rollback triggers
- comms: customer notified of TTL and extension flow
```

selene (research): small ask — add an eval bucket for long-tail prompts (5% sample) so we avoid hidden regressions on multi-turn. that was what tripped us last quarter.

aj (eng): question about canaries: recommended two-stage canary: 1% -> 5% over 48h -> 25% over 72h. rollback conditions: error-rate delta + eval metric regression. do we need a cost threshold to auto-abort?

samir (sde): yes add: abort if cost delta > 15% at 25% traffic (indicates perf incompatibility) or if daily token cost delta > $2000 for the tenant during canary.

maya (prod PM): on pin exception windows: Atlas asked for 6 months. ops position?

aj (eng): 6 months requires infra change and reserved capacity; we can do it under a dedicated contract (sales/legal). for a 90->180 day move we'd need an explicit capacity commit.

nora (support): Customer-facing language should be explicit: "soft pin" = we preserve routing to chosen model variant but may reroute in emergencies; "hard pin" = reserved capacity + contract. they care about "silent cut" - we must promise comms and graceful fallback.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary plan template available at https://internal.redwood/ops/canary-template :rocket:

maya (prod PM): decision proposal:
- approve 90-day soft pin by default
- 30-day auto extension via console opt-in (customer signs SLA checkbox)
- 180-day hard pin available only via reserved capacity contract (sales + infra)
- require two-stage canary (1% -> 5% -> ramp) with rollback on error-rate (0.5%), eval regression (>1% absolute), or cost delta (>15%)
- embed models require schema lock + embed-stability >= 0.88

samir (sde): +1 to proposal. i'll add automated canary checks to the rollout job and wire metric alerts. estimated work: 2 sprint days to add eval hooks, 3 days for cost checks.

selene (research): +1 but request we include the long-tail probe as a mandatory smokebench slice.

nora (support): +1, i'll draft the customer communication blurb and update the pin request form to include "requested TTL" and "contract needed for >90d" language.

maya (prod PM): ok looks like consensus. action items:
- samir: add canary eval hooks and cost checks (tickets: INF-1321)
- aj: document hw buckets and quant tradeoffs on the model page (PR by EOD Tue)
- nora: customer comms & support playbook
- selene: add long-tail eval slice and baseline run

please react with :white_check_mark: if you agree or drop blockers now. i'll update the catalog doc after reactions and capture the new TTL rules in the onboarding form.

aj (eng): :white_check_mark:

selene (research): :white_check_mark:

samir (sde): :white_check_mark: will start INF-1321 today

nora (support): :white_check_mark: drafting comms

maya (prod PM): thanks everyone — i'll publish the change once tickets are linked.
